sqlMap.select: /*DialogDgroffice010Sort.selectDgroffice010List*/ SELECT A.FIS_YEAR AS FIS_YEAR , A.BGT_DGR AS BGT_DGR , A.OFFICE_CD AS OFFICE_CD , A.OFFICE_RANK010 AS OFFICE_RANK010 , (SELECT Z.OFFICE_NM FROM TB_DGRDEPT Z WHERE Z.FIS_YEAR = A.FIS_YEAR AND Z.BGT_DGR = A.BGT_DGR AND Z.OFFICE_CD = A.OFFICE_CD AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS OFFICE_NM FROM TB_DGROFFICE010 A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND A.BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr# ORDER BY A.OFFICE_RANK010
sqlMap.update: /*DialogDgroffice010Sort.updateOfficeRank010*/ UPDATE TB_DGROFFICE010 A SET OFFICE_RANK010 = #officeRank010# , MODI_ID = #userId# , MODI_DATE = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND A.BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr# AND A.OFFICE_CD = #officeCd#
sqlMap.select: /*DialogDgroffice010Sort.selectDgroffice0F0List*/ SELECT A.FIS_YEAR AS FIS_YEAR , A.BGT_DGR AS BGT_DGR , A.OFFICE_CD AS OFFICE_CD , NVL(A.OFFICE_RANK0F0, A.OFFICE_RANK) AS OFFICE_RANK0F0 , (SELECT Z.OFFICE_NM FROM TB_DGRDEPT Z WHERE Z.FIS_YEAR = A.FIS_YEAR AND Z.BGT_DGR = A.BGT_DGR AND Z.OFFICE_CD = A.OFFICE_CD AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS OFFICE_NM FROM TB_DGROFFICE010 A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND A.BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr# ORDER BY NVL(A.OFFICE_RANK0F0, A.OFFICE_RANK)
sqlMap.update: /*DialogDgroffice010Sort.updateOfficeRank0F0*/ UPDATE TB_DGROFFICE010 A SET OFFICE_RANK0F0 = #officeRank0F0# , MODI_ID = #userId# , MODI_DATE = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND A.BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr# AND A.OFFICE_CD = #officeCd#

/*DialogDgroffice010Sort.initOfficeRank010*/ MERGE INTO TB_DGROFFICE010 A USING ( SELECT A.FIS_YEAR , A.BGT_DGR , A.OFFICE_CD , MAX(A.OFFICE_RANK) AS OFFICE_RANK , (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(Z.OFFICE_CD) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END OFFICE_YN FROM TB_DGROFFICE010 Z WHERE Z.FIS_YEAR = A.FIS_YEAR AND Z.BGT_DGR = A.BGT_DGR AND Z.OFFICE_CD = A.OFFICE_CD ) AS OFFICE_YN FROM TB_DGRDEPT_RLK A WHERE 1 = 1 AND TRNN_ID = (SELECT MAX(TRNN_ID) FROM TB_DGRDEPT_RLK WHERE FIS_YEAR = #fisYear# AND BGT_DGR = #bgtDgr#) GROUP BY A.FIS_YEAR , A.BGT_DGR , A.OFFICE_CD ) B ON A.FIS_YEAR = B.FIS_YEAR AND A.BGT_DGR = B.BGT_DGR AND A.OFFICE_CD = B.OFFICE_CD WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET OFFICE_RANK = B.OFFICE_RANK , OFFICE_RANK010 = B.OFFICE_RANK , MODI_ID = #userId# , MODI_DATE = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (A.FIS_YEAR, A.BGT_DGR, A.OFFICE_CD, A.OFFICE_RANK, A.OFFICE_RANK010, A.REGI_ID, A.REGI_DATE, A.MODI_ID, A.MODI_DATE ) VALUES (B.FIS_YEAR, B.BGT_DGR, B.OFFICE_CD, B.OFFICE_RANK, B.OFFICE_RANK, #userId#, SYSTIMESTAMP, #userId#, SYSTIMESTAMP)
